question: minecraft-3d-kandinsky
prompt: Write a web version of 3D Minecraft. - Trees - Make the textures clearer, use functions to hand-draw the textures yourself, in the Kandinsky style. Don't just write a link, it won't load. - Make the ground smoother. In a single-page, self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>3D Minecraft‑style Demo (Kandinsky textures)</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
<script>
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 1️⃣  BASIC THREE.JS SETUP
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const scene   = new THREE.Scene();
const camera  = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 2000);
camera.position.set(30, 30, 30);
camera.lookAt(0,0,0);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.1;

// simple lighting – just ambient so colours stay vivid
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.9));

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 2️⃣  PERLIN NOISE (tiny implementation)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const perm = new Uint8Array(512);
(() => {
  const p = new Uint8Array(256);
  for(let i=0;i<256;i++) p[i]=i;
  // shuffle
  for(let i=255;i>0;i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
    [p[i],p[j]]=[p[j],p[i]];
  }
  for(let i=0;i<512;i++) perm[i]=p[i & 255];
})();

function fade(t){ return t*t*t*(t*(t*6-15)+10); }
function lerp(a,b,t){ return a + t*(b-a); }
function grad(hash, x, y, z){
  const h = hash & 15;
  const u = h<8 ? x : y;
  const v = h<4 ? y : (h===12||h===14 ? x : z);
  return ((h&1)?-u:u) + ((h&2)?-v:v);
}
function perlin(x,y,z){
  const X = Math.floor(x) & 255;
  const Y = Math.floor(y) & 255;
  const Z = Math.floor(z) & 255;
  const xf = x - Math.floor(x);
  const yf = y - Math.floor(y);
  const zf = z - Math.floor(z);
  const u = fade(xf), v = fade(yf), w = fade(zf);
  const A  = perm[X] + Y, AA = perm[A] + Z, AB = perm[A+1] + Z;
  const B  = perm[X+1] + Y, BA = perm[B] + Z, BB = perm[B+1] + Z;

  const g1 = grad(perm[AA  ], xf  , yf  , zf  );
  const g2 = grad(perm[BA  ], xf-1, yf  , zf  );
  const g3 = grad(perm[AB  ], xf  , yf-1, zf  );
  const g4 = grad(perm[BB  ], xf-1, yf-1, zf  );
  const g5 = grad(perm[AA+1], xf  , yf  , zf-1);
  const g6 = grad(perm[BA+1], xf-1, yf  , zf-1);
  const g7 = grad(perm[AB+1], xf  , yf-1, zf-1);
  const g8 = grad(perm[BB+1], xf-1, yf-1, zf-1);

  const x1 = lerp(g1, g2, u);
  const x2 = lerp(g3, g4, u);
  const y1 = lerp(x1, x2, v);
  const x3 = lerp(g5, g6, u);
  const x4 = lerp(g7, g8, u);
  const y2 = lerp(x3, x4, v);
  return lerp(y1, y2, w);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 3️⃣  KANDINSKY‑STYLE TEXTURE GENERATOR
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function createKandinskyTexture(baseColor){
  const size = 64;               // 64×64 px – enough for a voxel
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = canvas.height = size;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // background – solid base colour
  ctx.fillStyle = baseColor;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);

  // random circles
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    ctx.beginPath();
    const r = Math.random()*size*0.3;
    const x = Math.random()*size;
    const y = Math.random()*size;
    ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${Math.random()*360},80%,60%,0.5)`;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // random lines
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(Math.random()*size, Math.random()*size);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.random()*size, Math.random()*size);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${Math.random()*360},80%,50%,0.7)`;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.random()*3+1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // small colour blocks
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const w = Math.random()*size*0.4;
    const h = Math.random()*size*0.4;
    const x = Math.random()*(size-w);
    const y = Math.random()*(size-h);
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${Math.random()*360},70%,70%,0.6)`;
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  }

  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;   // keep voxel look
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  return tex;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 4️⃣  MATERIALS (using the hand‑drawn textures)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const texGrass = createKandinskyTexture('#7cfc00');   // bright green
const texDirt  = createKandinskyTexture('#8b4513');   // brown
const texWood  = createKandinskyTexture('#a0522d');   // darker brown
const texLeaf  = createKandinskyTexture('#32cd32');   // leaf green

const matGrass = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map: texGrass});
const matDirt  = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map: texDirt});
const matWood  = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map: texWood});
const matLeaf  = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map: texLeaf});

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 5️⃣  WORLD PARAMETERS
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const WORLD_SIZE = 32;          // 32×32 voxels
const MAX_HEIGHT = 12;         // max column height
const SCALE = 1;               // size of one voxel

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 6️⃣  BUILD GROUND (smooth hills)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const cubeGeom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(SCALE, SCALE, SCALE);
function addVoxel(x,y,z, material){
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(cubeGeom, material);
  mesh.position.set(
    x * SCALE,
    y * SCALE,
    z * SCALE
  );
  scene.add(mesh);
}

// generate height map with Perlin noise
const heightMap = [];
for(let x=0;x<WORLD_SIZE;x++){
  heightMap[x] = [];
  for(let z=0;z<WORLD_SIZE;z++){
    const nx = x / WORLD_SIZE - 0.5;
    const nz = z / WORLD_SIZE - 0.5;
    // multiple octaves for smoother hills
    let e = 0;
    let amp = 1, freq = 1;
    for(let o=0;o<4;o++){
      e += amp * perlin(nx*freq*4, nz*freq*4, 0);
      amp *= 0.5;
      freq *= 2;
    }
    const h = Math.round(((e+1)/2) * (MAX_HEIGHT-4)) + 4; // keep at least 4 blocks high
    heightMap[x][z] = h;
  }
}

// place ground voxels
for(let x=0;x<WORLD_SIZE;x++){
  for(let z=0;z<WORLD_SIZE;z++){
    const h = heightMap[x][z];
    for(let y=0;y<h;y++){
      const mat = (y===h-1) ? matGrass : matDirt; // top block = grass
      addVoxel(x, y, z, mat);
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 7️⃣  TREE PLACEMENT
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function placeTree(baseX, baseZ){
  const trunkHeight = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
  const groundY = heightMap[baseX][baseZ];

  // trunk
  for(let y=0;y<trunkHeight;y++){
    addVoxel(baseX, groundY + y, baseZ, matWood);
  }

  // leaves – simple cube around the top
  const leafStart = groundY + trunkHeight - 2;
  for(let x=-2;x<=2;x++){
    for(let y=-2;y<=2;y++){
      for(let z=-2;z<=2;z++){
        const dist = Math.abs(x)+Math.abs(y)+Math.abs(z);
        if(dist <= 3){ // make a roughly spherical shape
          addVoxel(baseX+x, leafStart+y, baseZ+z, matLeaf);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// randomly scatter a few trees
const TREE_COUNT = 30;
for(let i=0;i<TREE_COUNT;i++){
  const x = Math.floor(Math.random()*WORLD_SIZE);
  const z = Math.floor(Math.random()*WORLD_SIZE);
  // avoid placing on very steep slopes
  const h = heightMap[x][z];
  const neighbours = [
    heightMap[(x+1)%WORLD_SIZE][z],
    heightMap[(x-1+WORLD_SIZE)%WORLD_SIZE][z],
    heightMap[x][(z+1)%WORLD_SIZE],
    heightMap[x][(z-1+WORLD_SIZE)%WORLD_SIZE]
  ];
  const maxDiff = Math.max(...neighbours.map(v=>Math.abs(v-h)));
  if(maxDiff < 3) placeTree(x,z);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 8️⃣  RENDER LOOP & RESPONSIVE RESIZE
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

window.addEventListener('resize',()=> {
  const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w,h);
  camera.aspect = w/h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Kandinsky Minecraft</title>
    <style>body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.126.1/build/three.module.js';

    // --- KANDINSKY TEXTURE GENERATOR ---
    function createKandinskyTexture(color, type) {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 64;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        
        if (type === 'grass') {
            ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700"; // Kandinsky Yellow
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(32, 32, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        } else if (type === 'wood') {
            ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(64, 64); ctx.stroke();
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = "#FF4500"; // Kandinsky Red
            ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 44, 44);
        }
        return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    }

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Textures
    const grassTex = createKandinskyTexture("#228B22", 'grass');
    const woodTex = createKandinskyTexture("#8B4513", 'wood');
    const leafTex = createKandinskyTexture("#32CD32", 'leaf');

    // Smooth Ground
    for(let x = -10; x < 10; x++) {
        for(let z = -10; z < 10; z++) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: grassTex});
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            cube.position.set(x, -0.5, z);
            scene.add(cube);
        }
    }

    // Trees
    function createTree(x, z) {
        const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 2, 0.5), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: woodTex}));
        trunk.position.set(x, 0.5, z);
        scene.add(trunk);
        const leaves = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 8, 8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map: leafTex}));
        leaves.position.set(x, 2, z);
        scene.add(leaves);
    }
    createTree(2, 2); createTree(-3, 5); createTree(5, -4);

    camera.position.z = 5;
    camera.position.y = 3;
    camera.lookAt(0,0,0);

    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        camera.position.x = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0005) * 10;
        camera.position.z = Math.cos(Date.now() * 0.0005) * 10;
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Mini‑Minecraft (Kandinsky style)</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
/* --------------------------------------------------------------
   Minimal Minecraft‑like demo – one page, no external assets
   -------------------------------------------------------------- */

import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.165.0/build/three.module.js';
import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.165.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

/* ---------- Helper: draw a Kandinsky‑style texture on a canvas ---------- */
function makeKandinskyTexture(width, height, palette) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = width; canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // background
  ctx.fillStyle = palette.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  // random geometric shapes – the essence of Kandinsky
  const shapes = 12;
  for (let i = 0; i < shapes; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = palette[Math.floor(Math.random()*palette.length)];
    const type = Math.random();
    const x = Math.random()*width;
    const y = Math.random()*height;
    const size = 10 + Math.random()*30;

    if (type < 0.33) {               // circle
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, size/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (type < 0.66) {        // rectangle
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
    } else {                         // triangle
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - size/2);
      ctx.lineTo(x - size/2, y + size/2);
      ctx.lineTo(x + size/2, y + size/2);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // return as Three.js texture
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  tex.repeat.set(4,4);   // repeat to cover larger surfaces
  return tex;
}

/* ---------- Scene, camera, renderer ---------- */
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb); // sky blue

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(15, 12, 15);
camera.lookAt(0,0,0);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

/* ---------- Controls ---------- */
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;

/* ---------- Light ---------- */
const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
scene.add(ambient);
const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
dirLight.position.set(10,20,10);
scene.add(dirLight);

/* ---------- Ground (smooth plane) ---------- */
const groundSize = 50;
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize, 64, 64); // many segments → smooth
groundGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
  map: makeKandinskyTexture(256,256, [
    '#ff6f61', '#6b5b95', '#88b04b', '#f7cac9',
    '#92a8d1', '#955251', '#b565a7', '#009b77',
    '#ffdf00', '#000000', '#ffffff'
  ])
});
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
scene.add(ground);

/* ---------- Simple terrain blocks (grass) ---------- */
const blockSize = 1;
const blockGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(blockSize, blockSize, blockSize);
const grassMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
  map: makeKandinskyTexture(128,128, [
    '#6b8e23', '#556b2f', '#8fbc8f', '#2e8b57',
    '#66cdaa', '#228b22', '#20b2aa', '#008000'
  ])
});
function placeBlock(x,y,z){
  const b = new THREE.Mesh(blockGeo, grassMat);
  b.position.set(x*blockSize, y*blockSize, z*blockSize);
  scene.add(b);
}
// a tiny flat hill
for(let i=-5;i<=5;i++){
  for(let j=-5;j<=5;j++){
    const h = Math.max(0, 2 - Math.sqrt(i*i+j*j));

    <script type="module">
        // Import core Three.js libraries from reliable CDN
        import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.158.0/build/three.module.js';
        import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.158.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

        // --------------------------
        // Kandinsky Style Texture Generator (hand-drawn via canvas)
        // --------------------------
        function generateKandinskyTexture(type) {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 512;
            canvas.height = 512;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            // Base colors per block type
            const baseColors = {
                grassTop: '#3CB371',
                dirt: '#8B5A2B',
                wood: '#704214',
                leaves: '#228B22',
                stone: '#808080'
            };
            ctx.fillStyle = baseColors[type] || '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0,0,512,512);

            // Add Kandinsky signature abstract geometric elements
            ctx.lineWidth = 8;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';

            // Bold intersecting lines (core Kandinsky trait)
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,170); ctx.lineTo(512,170); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,342); ctx.lineTo(512,342); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(170,0); ctx.lineTo(170,512); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(342,0); ctx.lineTo(342,512); ctx.stroke();

            // Primary color abstract shapes
            const shapes = [
                {type: 'circle', x: 100, y: 100, r: 60, color: '#FFD700'},
                {type: 'triangle', x: 400, y: 400, s: 80, color: '#1E90FF'},
                {type: 'square', x: 350, y: 80, s: 70, color: '#FF0000'},
                {type: 'circle', x: 80, y: 420, r: 50, color: '#FFFFFF'}
            ];

            shapes.forEach(shape => {
                ctx.fillStyle = shape.color;
                ctx.beginPath();
                if(shape.type === 'circle') {
                    ctx.arc(shape.x, shape.y, shape.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
                } else if(shape.type === 'triangle') {
                    ctx.moveTo(shape.x, shape.y - shape.s/2);
                    ctx.lineTo(shape.x - shape.s/2, shape.y + shape.s/2);
                    ctx.lineTo(shape.x + shape.s/2, shape.y + shape.s/2);
                    ctx.closePath();
                } else if(shape.type === 'square') {
                    ctx.rect(shape.x - shape.s/2, shape.y - shape.s/2, shape.s, shape.s);
                }
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.stroke();
            });

            return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
        }

        // Preload all block textures
        const textures = {
            grass: generateKandinskyTexture('grassTop'),
            dirt: generateKandinskyTexture('dirt'),
            wood: generateKandinskyTexture('wood'),
            leaves: generateKandinskyTexture('leaves'),
            stone: generateKandinskyTexture('stone')
        };

        // --------------------------
        // Scene Setup
        // --------------------------
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        sunLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
        sunLight.castShadow = true;
        sunLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
        sunLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
        scene.add(sunLight);

        // Controls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.target.set(0, 2, 0);
        controls.minDistance = 10;
        controls.maxDistance = 80;
        controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2.1; // Prevent going under ground
        camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);
        controls.update();

        // --------------------------
        // Smooth Ground (non-blocky, subtle terrain waves)
        // --------------------------
        const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100, 50, 50); // Subdivided for smooth terrain
        const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map: textures.grass});
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        ground.receiveShadow = true;

        // Add gentle height variations for smooth rolling terrain
        const vertices = groundGeometry.attributes.position.array;
        for(let i = 0; i < vertices.length; i += 3) {
            const x = vertices[i];
            const z = vertices[i+1];
            vertices[i+2] = Math.sin(x * 0.15) * Math.cos(z * 0.15) * 0.8; // Subtle waves
        }
        groundGeometry.computeVertexNormals(); // Ensure smooth lighting
        scene.add(ground);

        // --------------------------
        // Tree Spawner
        // --------------------------
        function spawnTree(x, z) {
            // Trunk
            const trunkGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 4, 1);
            const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map: textures.wood});
            const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(trunkGeometry, trunkMaterial);
            trunk.position.set(x, 2, z);
            trunk.castShadow = true;
            scene.add(trunk);

            // Leaf cluster (rounded, organic shape)
            const leafMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map: textures.leaves});
            const leafPositions = [
                [0,5,0], [1,5,0], [-1,5,0], [0,5,1], [0,5,-1],
                [0,6.5,0], [0.7,6,0.7], [-0.7,6,0.7], [0.7,6,-0.7], [-0.7,6,-0.7]
            ];
            leafPositions.forEach(pos => {
                const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.8, 1.8, 1.8), leafMaterial);
                leaf.position.set(x + pos[0], pos[1], z + pos[2]);
                leaf.castShadow = true;
                scene.add(leaf);
            });
        }

        // Spawn 18 random trees across the world
        for(let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
            const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
            spawnTree(x, z);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <canvas id="myCanvas"></canvas>

    <script>
        // Get the canvas element
        const canvas = document.getElementById('myCanvas');
        const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl');

        // Set the canvas size
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        // Vertex shader
        const vertexShader = gl.createShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER);
        gl.shaderSource(vertexShader, `
            attribute vec3 position;
            attribute vec2 uv;
            varying vec2 vUv;
            uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;
            uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
            void main() {
                vUv = uv;
                gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
            }
        `);
        gl.compileShader(vertexShader);

        // Fragment shader
        const fragmentShader = gl.createShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER);
        gl.shaderSource(fragmentShader, `
            precision highp float;
            varying vec2 vUv;
            uniform sampler2D texture;
            void main() {
                gl_FragColor = texture2D(texture, vUv);
            }
        `);
        gl.compileShader(fragmentShader);

        // Create the program
        const program = gl.createProgram();
        gl.attachShader(program, vertexShader);
        gl.attachShader(program, fragmentShader);
        gl.linkProgram(program);
        gl.useProgram(program);

        // Define the vertices and UVs for a cube
        const vertices = new Float32Array([
            -0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0,
            0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 0.0,
            0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0,
            -0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 1.0,
            -0.5, -0.5, -0.5, 0.0, 0.0,
            0.5, -0.5, -0.5, 1.0, 0.0,
            0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 1.0, 1.0,
            -0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.0, 1.0
        ]);

        // Create a buffer for the vertices and UVs
        const buffer = gl.createBuffer();
        gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buffer);
        gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vertices, gl.STATIC_DRAW);

        // Get the attribute locations
        const positionAttrib = gl.getAttribLocation(program, 'position');
        const uvAttrib = gl.getAttribLocation(program, 'uv');

        // Enable the attribute arrays
        gl.enableVertexAttribArray(positionAttrib);
        gl.enableVertexAttribArray(uvAttrib);

        // Set the attribute pointers
        gl.vertexAttribPointer(positionAttrib, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 20, 0);
        gl.vertexAttribPointer(uvAttrib, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 20, 12);

        // Get the uniform locations
        const modelViewMatrixUniform = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'modelViewMatrix');
        const projectionMatrixUniform = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'projectionMatrix');
        const textureUniform = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'texture');

        // Create the texture
        const texture = gl.createTexture();
        gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, texture);
        gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, 256, 256, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);

        // Define the Kandinsky-style texture
        function drawTexture(gl, texture, data) {
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, texture);
            gl.texSubImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0, 256, 256, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, data);
        }

        const textureData = new Uint8Array(256 * 256 * 4);
        for (let i = 0; i < 256 * 256; i++) {
            const x = i % 256;
            const y = Math.floor(i / 256);
            const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
            const g = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
            const b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
            textureData[i * 4 + 0] = r;
            textureData[i * 4 + 1] = g;
            textureData[i * 4 + 2] = b;
            textureData[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
        }
        drawTexture(gl, texture, textureData);

        // Set the projection and model-view matrices
        const projectionMatrix = mat4.create();
        mat4.perspective(projectionMatrix, Math.PI / 4, canvas.width / canvas.height, 0.1, 100.0);
        const modelViewMatrix = mat4.create();

        // Render the scene
        function render() {
            gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

            // Render the ground
            mat4.identity(modelViewMatrix);
            mat4.translate(modelViewMatrix, modelViewMatrix, [0, -2, -5]);
            mat4.scale(modelViewMatrix, modelViewMatrix, [10, 0.1, 10]);
            gl.uniformMatrix4fv(modelViewMatrixUniform, false, modelViewMatrix);
            gl.uniformMatrix4fv(projectionMatrixUniform, false, projectionMatrix);
            gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_FAN, 0, 4);

            // Render the trees
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                mat4.identity(modelViewMatrix);
                mat4.translate(modelViewMatrix, modelViewMatrix, [Math.random() * 10 - 5, 0, Math.random() * 10 - 5]);
                mat4.scale(modelViewMatrix, modelViewMatrix, [0.5, 2, 0.5]);
                gl.uniformMatrix4fv(modelViewMatrixUniform, false, modelViewMatrix);
                gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_FAN, 0, 4);
                mat4.identity(modelViewMatrix);

        camera.position.x = Math.cos(angle) * 20;
        camera.position.z = Math.sin(angle) * 20;
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
        
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    animate();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Kandinsky Craft</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { width: 100%; height: 100% }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/three@0.132.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/three@0.132.2/examples/js/controls/PointerLockControls.js"></script>

<script>
// Texture generator functions in Kandinsky style
function createGrassTexture() {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 64;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    // Kandinsky-style abstract patterns
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3d5a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b8c21';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    for(let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(Math.random()*64, Math.random()*64, 10, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
    return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
}

function createWoodTexture() {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 64;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    // Abstract linear patterns
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3b1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8c6b21';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    for(let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(32, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(32 + Math.random()*20-10, 64);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
    return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
}

function createLeafTexture() {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 64;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    // Circular Kandinsky elements
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a5a3d';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#218c6b';
    for(let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(Math.random()*64, Math.random()*64, 8, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
}

// Scene setup
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

// Lighting
const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
scene.add(ambientLight);
const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
scene.add(directionalLight);

// Generate smoothed terrain
const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100, 50, 50);
groundGeometry.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
    color: 0x88aa55,
    wireframe: false,
    flatShading: true
});
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
scene.add(ground);

// Generate trees
function createTree(x, z) {
    const textures = {
        wood: createWoodTexture(),
        leaves: createLeafTexture()
    };

    // Trunk
    const trunkHeight = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
    for(let y = 1; y <= trunkHeight; y++) {
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ map: textures.wood });
        const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        cube.position.set(x, y, z);
        scene.add(cube);
    }

    // Leaves
    const leafSize = 3;
    const top = trunkHeight + 1;
    for(let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for(let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
            for(let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
                const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
                const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ map: textures.leaves });
                const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
                cube.position.set(x + dx, top + dy, z + dz);
                scene.add(cube);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Generate random trees
for(let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const x = Math.random() * 80 - 40;
    const z = Math.random() * 80 - 40;
    createTree(x, z);
}

// Camera and controls
camera.position.y = 2;
camera.position.z = 5;

const controls = new THREE.PointerLockControls(camera, document.body);
scene.add(controls.getObject());

document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    controls.lock();
});

// Movement
const moveSpeed = 0.1;
const keys = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    
    if(controls.isLocked) {
        if(keys.w]) camera.translateZ(-moveSpeed);
        if(keys.s]) camera.translateZ(moveSpeed);
        if(keys.a]) camera.translateX(-moveSpeed);
        if(keys.d]) camera.translateX(moveSpeed);
    }
    
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

// Window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Write a web version of 3D Minecraft. - Trees - Make the textures clearer, use functions to hand-draw the textures yourself, in the Kandinsky style. Don't just write a link, it won't load. - Make the ground smoother. In a single-page, self-contained HTML.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>3D Minecraft - Kandinsky Style</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        // Set canvas size
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        
        // Game constants
        const BLOCK_SIZE = 40;
        const PLAYER_HEIGHT = BLOCK_SIZE * 1.8;
        const GRAVITY = 0.4;
        const JUMP_FORCE = 10;
        const MOVEMENT_SPEED = 5;
        
        // Game state
        const player = {
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            z: PLAYER_HEIGHT,
            velocityY: 0,
            isJumping: false,
            rotation: 0, // in radians
            pitch: 0,    // vertical look angle
            speed: MOVEMENT_SPEED
        };
        
        // World data
        const worldSize = 20;
        const world = [];
        
        // Initialize world
        function initWorld() {
            // Create empty world
            for (let x = 0; x < worldSize; x++) {
                world[x] = [];
                for (let z = 0; z < worldSize; z++) {
                    world[x][z] = [];
                    for (let y = 0; y < worldSize; y++) {
                        world[x][z][y] = 0; // 0 = air
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Create ground
            for (let x = 0; x < worldSize; x++) {
                for (let z = 0; z < worldSize; z++) {
                    // Smoother terrain using sine function
                    const height = Math.floor(5 + 3 * Math.sin(x/3) * Math.cos(z/3));
                    for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                        if (y === height - 1) {
                            world[x][z][y] = 2; // Grass on top
                        } else if (y > height - 4) {
                            world[x][z][y] = 3; // Dirt below grass
                        } else {
                            world[x][z][y] = 1; // Stone deeper down
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Add some trees
            addTree(5, worldSize-5, 5);
            addTree(10, 10, 5);
            addTree(15, 5, 5);
            addTree(8, 12, 5);
            addTree(12, 8, 5);
            
            // Set player position
            player.x = worldSize / 2 * BLOCK_SIZE;
            player.y = worldSize / 2 * BLOCK_SIZE;
        }
        
        function addTree(x, z, groundHeight) {
            // Tree trunk (5 blocks high)
            for (let y = groundHeight; y < groundHeight + 5; y++) {
                world[x][z][y] = 4; // Wood
            }
            
            // Tree leaves (2 layers)
            const leafStart = groundHeight + 3;
            for (let ly = leafStart; ly < groundHeight + 7; ly++) {
                for (let lx = x - 2; lx <= x + 2; lx++) {
                    for (let lz = z - 2; lz <= z + 2; lz++) {
                        // Skip corners for a more natural shape
                        if ((lx === x - 2 && lz === z - 2) || 
                            (lx === x - 2 && lz === z + 2) || 
                            (lx === x + 2 && lz === z - 2) || 
                            (lx === x + 2 && lz === z + 2)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        if (lx >= 0 && lx < worldSize && lz >= 0 && lz < worldSize && 
                            ly >= 0 && ly < worldSize) {
                            world[lx][lz][ly] = 5; // Leaves
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Hand-drawn Kandinsky-style textures
        function drawBlockTexture(type, ctx, x, y, size) {
            ctx.save();
            
            switch(type) {
                case 1: // Stone
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
                    
                    // Kandinsky-style abstract lines
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#555555';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size);
                        ctx.lineTo(x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    
                    // Circles
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#666666';
                    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                        const circleSize = Math.random() * size/4;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size, 
                                circleSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                    break;
                    
                case 2: // Grass
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#55aa55';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
                    
                    // Abstract grass patterns
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#336633';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(x + size/2, y + size/2);
                        ctx.lineTo(x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    
                    // Colorful dots
                    const dotColors = ['#88cc88', '#aaddaa', '#66bb66'];
                    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = dotColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * dotColors.length)];
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size, 
                                Math.random() * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                    break;
                    
                case 3: // Dirt
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
                    
                    // Organic dirt patterns
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a2e0a';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size);
                        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
                            x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size,
                            x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size,
                            x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size
                        );
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    break;
                    
                case 4: // Wood (tree trunk)
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
                    
                    // Tree rings
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a2e0a';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                        const offset = size * 0.1;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.ellipse(
                            x + size/2, y + size/2,
                            size/2 - offset * i, size/4 - offset * i,
                            0, 0, Math.PI * 2
                        );
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    
                    // Vertical lines
                    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(x + size/2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * size/3, y);
                        ctx.lineTo(x + size/2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * size/3, y + size);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    break;
                    
                case 5: // Leaves
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#55cc55';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
                    
                    // Abstract leaf patterns
                    const leafColors = ['#66dd66', '#44bb44', '#77ee77'];
                    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = leafColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * leafColors.length)];
                        const leafSize = Math.random() * size/3;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.ellipse(
                            x + Math.random() * size, y + Math.random() * size,
                            leafSize, leafSize * 0.7,
                            Math.random() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2
                        );
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                    break;
                    
                default:
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size);
            }
            
            ctx.restore();
        }
        
        // Pre-render block textures
        const blockTextures = {};
        function createBlockTextures() {
            const textureCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            textureCanvas.width = BLOCK_SIZE;
            textureCanvas.height = BLOCK_SIZE;
            const textureCtx = textureCanvas.getContext('2d');
            
            for (let type = 1; type <= 5; type++) {
                drawBlockTexture(type, textureCtx, 0, 0, BLOCK_SIZE);
                blockTextures[type] = new Image();
                blockTextures[type].src = textureCanvas.toDataURL();
                textureCtx.clearRect(0, 0, BLOCK_SIZE, BLOCK_SIZE);
            }
        }
        
        // 3D rendering
        function render() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Draw sky
            const skyGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
            skyGradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
            skyGradient.addColorStop(1, '#E0F7FA');
            ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Draw horizon line
            const horizonY = canvas.height / 2 - player.pitch * 50;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#555555';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(0, horizonY);
            ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, horizonY);
            ctx.stroke();
            
            // Collect visible blocks sorted by distance
            const visibleBlocks = [];
            const renderDistance = 10;
            
            const playerBlockX = Math.floor(player.x / BLOCK_SIZE);
            const playerBlockZ = Math.floor(player.y / BLOCK_SIZE);
            
            for (let x = Math.max(0, playerBlockX - renderDistance); 
                 x < Math.min(worldSize, playerBlockX + renderDistance); x++) {
                for (let z = Math.max(0, playerBlockZ - renderDistance); 
                     z < Math.min(worldSize, playerBlockZ + renderDistance); z++) {
                    for (let y = 0; y < worldSize; y++) {
                        if (world[x][z][y] > 0) {
                            // Calculate distance from player
                            const blockCenterX = x * BLOCK_SIZE + BLOCK_SIZE/2;
                            const blockCenterZ = z * BLOCK_SIZE + BLOCK_SIZE/2;
                            const blockCenterY = y * BLOCK_SIZE + BLOCK_SIZE/2;
                            
                            const dx = blockCenterX - player.x;
                            const dy = blockCenterY - player.z;
                            const dz = blockCenterZ - player.y;
                            
                            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
                            visibleBlocks.push({
                                type: world[x][z][y],
                                x: x,
                                y: y,
                                z: z,
                                distance: distance
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Sort blocks by distance (farthest first)
            visibleBlocks.sort((a, b) => b.distance - a.distance);
            
            // Draw blocks
            for (const block of visibleBlocks) {
                drawBlock(block.x, block.y, block.z, block.type);
            }
            
            // Draw player (simple representation)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2, 5, 0, Math.PI*2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        
        function drawBlock(x, y, z, type) {
            // Convert world coordinates to screen coordinates
            const worldX = x * BLOCK_SIZE - player.x;
            const worldY = y * BLOCK_SIZE - player.z;
            const worldZ = z * BLOCK_SIZE - player.y;
            
            // Apply rotation
            const rotatedX = worldX * Math.cos(player.rotation) - worldZ * Math.sin(player.rotation);
            const rotatedZ = worldX * Math.sin(player.rotation) + worldZ * Math.cos(player.rotation);
            
            // Perspective projection
            const scale = 1000 / (rotatedZ + 1000);
            const screenX = canvas.width/2 + rotatedX * scale;
            const screenY = canvas.height/2 - worldY * scale - player.pitch * 100;
            
            // Only draw if block is in front of player
            if (rotatedZ > -BLOCK_SIZE) {
                const blockSize = BLOCK_SIZE * scale;
                
                // Draw the block texture
                if (blockTextures[type]) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.translate(screenX, screenY);
                    ctx.scale(scale, scale);
                    ctx.drawImage(blockTextures[type], -blockSize/2/scale, -blockSize/2/scale);
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Player movement
        function updatePlayer() {
            // Apply gravity
            player.velocityY -= GRAVITY;
            player.z += player.velocityY;
            
            // Check if player is on the ground
            const playerBlockX = Math.floor(player.x / BLOCK_SIZE);
            const playerBlockZ = Math.floor(player.y / BLOCK_SIZE);
            const playerBlockY = Math.floor(player.z / BLOCK_SIZE);
            
            if (player.z < 0) player.z = 0;
            
            if (playerBlockY >= 0 && playerBlockY < worldSize && 
                playerBlockX >= 0 && playerBlockX < worldSize && 
                playerBlockZ >= 0 && playerBlockZ < worldSize) {
                
                // Check block below player
                if (world[playerBlockX][playerBlockZ][playerBlockY - 1] > 0) {
                    player.z = playerBlockY * BLOCK_SIZE;
                    player.velocityY = 0;
                    player.isJumping = false;
                }
            }
            
            // Movement
            let moveX = 0;
            let moveZ = 0;
            
            if (keys['w']) {
                moveX += Math.sin(player.rotation) * player.speed;
                moveZ += Math.cos(player.rotation) * player.speed;
            }
            if (keys['s']) {
                moveX -= Math.sin(player.rotation) * player.speed;
                moveZ -= Math.cos(player.rotation) * player.speed;
            }
            if (keys['a']) {
                moveX -= Math.cos(player.rotation) * player.speed;
                moveZ += Math.sin(player.rotation) * player.speed;
            }
            if (keys['d']) {
                moveX += Math.cos(player.rotation) * player.speed;
                moveZ -= Math.sin(player.rotation) * player.speed;
            }
            
            // Normalize diagonal movement
            if (moveX !== 0 && moveZ !== 0) {
                const len = Math.sqrt(moveX * moveX + moveZ * moveZ);
                moveX = moveX / len * player.speed;
                moveZ = moveZ / len * player.speed;
            }
            
            // Apply movement
            player.x += moveX;
            player.y += moveZ;
            
            // Keep player within world bounds
            player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(worldSize * BLOCK_SIZE - 1, player.x));
            player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(worldSize * BLOCK_SIZE - 1, player.y));
        }
        
        // Keyboard input
        const keys = {};
        
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            // Jump
            if (e.key === ' ' && !player.isJumping) {
                player.velocityY = JUMP_FORCE;
                player.isJumping = true;
            }
        });
        
        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });
        
        // Mouse look
        let isMouseDown = false;
        let lastMouseX = 0;
        
        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            isMouseDown = true;
            lastMouseX = e.clientX;
            canvas.requestPointerLock = canvas.requestPointerLock || 
                                       canvas.mozRequestPointerLock || 
                                       canvas.webkitRequestPointerLock;
            canvas.requestPointerLock();
        });
        
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            isMouseDown = false;
            document.exitPointerLock = document.exitPointerLock || 
                                      document.mozExitPointerLock || 
                                      document.webkitExitPointerLock;
            document.exitPointerLock();
        });
        
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            if (isMouseDown) {
                const deltaX = e.movementX || 
                              e.mozMovementX || 
                              e.webkitMovementX || 
                              0;
                
                player.rotation -= deltaX * 0.002;
                
                const deltaY = e.movementY || 
                               e.mozMovementY || 
                               e.webkitMovementY || 
                               0;
                
                player.pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI/4, Math.min(Math.PI/4, player.pitch - deltaY * 0.002));
            }
        });
        
        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        });
        
        // Game loop
        function gameLoop() {
            updatePlayer();
            render();
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }
        
        // Initialize and start the game
        initWorld();
        createBlockTextures();
        gameLoop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

const canvas = document.getElementById('myCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

// 3D Camera Parameters
let cameraX = 0;
let cameraY = 0;
let cameraZ = -500;
const zoomSpeed = 0.01;
const rotateSpeedX = 0.005;
const rotateSpeedY = 0.005;

// --- Texture Generation (Kandinsky Style) ---
function generateKandinskyTexture(width, height) {
    const texture = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < height; i++) {
        texture[i] = [];
        for (let j = 0; j < width; j++) {
            const r = Math.random();
            const g = Math.random();
            const b = Math.random();
            const a = Math.random(); // Alpha (transparency)

            // Kandinsky-inspired color variations
            const hue = Math.random() * 360;
            const saturation = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3;
            const brightness = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;

            const color = `hsl(${hue}, ${saturation}, ${brightness})`;
            texture[i][j] = color;
        }
    }
    return texture;
}

// --- Tree Generation ---
function generateTreeTexture(width, height) {
    const texture = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < height; i++) {
        texture[i] = [];
        for (let j = 0; j < width; j++) {
            const r = Math.random();
            const g = Math.random();
            const b = Math.random();
            const a = 1;

            // Tree-like color variation
            const hue = Math.random() * 180; // More green-ish
            const saturation = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4;
            const brightness = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4;
            const color = `hsl(${hue}, ${saturation}, ${brightness})`;

            texture[i][j] = color;
        }
    }
    return texture;
}



// --- 3D Rendering ---

const treeTexture = generateTreeTexture(64, 64);
const groundTexture = generateKandinskyTexture(128, 128); //Smoother ground

function drawTree(x, y, z, scale) {
    const treeWidth = 64 * scale;
    const treeHeight = 128 * scale;

    //Draw the trunk
    ctx.fillStyle = 'brown';  //Basic trunk color
    ctx.fillRect(x - treeWidth / 2, y - treeHeight, treeWidth, treeHeight / 3);

    //Draw the leaves using the texture
    for (let i = 0; i < treeHeight; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < treeWidth; j++) {
            const leafScale = (i / treeHeight) * scale;
            const leafX = x + j * scale - treeWidth / 2;
            const leafY = y + i * scale - treeHeight;
            ctx.fillStyle = treeTexture[Math.floor(i * scale)][j % treeWidth];
            ctx.fillRect(leafX, leafY, leafScale, leafScale);
        }
    }
}


function drawGround() {
    const groundWidth = canvas.width;
    const groundHeight = canvas.height / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = groundTexture[Math.floor(canvas.width / 2)][Math.floor(canvas.height/2)];
    ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height / 2, groundWidth, groundHeight);
}


function render() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Draw the ground
    drawGround();

    // Draw some trees
    drawTree(0, canvas.height / 2 - 50, 0, 1);
    drawTree(200, canvas.height / 2 - 70, 300, 0.8);
    drawTree(500, canvas.height / 2 - 30, 600, 0.6);



    // Camera controls (basic)
    const dx = cameraX - lastCameraX;
    const dy = cameraY - lastCameraY;
    const dz = cameraZ - lastCameraZ;

    cameraX += dx * rotateSpeedX;
    cameraY += dy * rotateSpeedY;
    cameraZ += dz * zoomSpeed;

    lastCameraX = cameraX;
    lastCameraY = cameraY;
    lastCameraZ = cameraZ;

    requestAnimationFrame(render);
}

//Initial values
let lastCameraX = 0;
let lastCameraY = 0;
let lastCameraZ = -500;

// Setup
canvas.style.position = 'absolute';
canvas.style.left = '0';
canvas.style.top = '0';

render();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<title>3D Minecraft-like Scene with Kandinsky Textures</title>
<style>
  body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="glcanvas"></canvas>
<script>
// Vertex shader program
const vsSource = `
attribute vec4 aVertexPosition;
attribute vec2 aTextureCoord;

uniform mat4 uModelViewMatrix;
uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix;

varying highp vec2 vTextureCoord;

void main(void) {
  gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * uModelViewMatrix * aVertexPosition;
  vTextureCoord = aTextureCoord;
}
`;

// Fragment shader program
const fsSource = `
varying highp vec2 vTextureCoord;

uniform sampler2D uSampler;

void main(void) {
  gl_FragColor = texture2D(uSampler, vTextureCoord);
}
`;

// Initialize WebGL context
const canvas = document.getElementById('glcanvas');
const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl');

if (!gl) {
  alert('Unable to initialize WebGL. Your browser may not support it.');
}

// Resize canvas to fit window
function resizeCanvas() {
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
resizeCanvas();

// Compile shader
function loadShader(gl, type, source) {
  const shader = gl.createShader(type);
  gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
  gl.compileShader(shader);
  if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
    alert('An error occurred compiling the shaders:' + gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
    gl.deleteShader(shader);
    return null;
  }
  return shader;
}

// Initialize shader program
function initShaderProgram(gl, vsSource, fsSource) {
  const vertexShader = loadShader(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vsSource);
  const fragmentShader = loadShader(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fsSource);

  const shaderProgram = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(shaderProgram, vertexShader);
  gl.attachShader(shaderProgram, fragmentShader);
  gl.linkProgram(shaderProgram);

  if (!gl.getProgramParameter(shaderProgram, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
    alert('Unable to initialize the shader program: ' + gl.getProgramInfoLog(shaderProgram));
    return null;
  }
  return shaderProgram;
}

const shaderProgram = initShaderProgram(gl, vsSource, fsSource);
const programInfo = {
  program: shaderProgram,
  attribLocations: {
    vertexPosition: gl.getAttribLocation(shaderProgram, 'aVertexPosition'),
    textureCoord: gl.getAttribLocation(shaderProgram, 'aTextureCoord'),
  },
  uniformLocations: {
    projectionMatrix: gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'uProjectionMatrix'),
    modelViewMatrix: gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'uModelViewMatrix'),
    uSampler: gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'uSampler'),
  },
};

// Function to create a textured cube
function initCubeBuffers(gl) {
  // Positions
  const positions = [
    // Front face
    -0.5, -0.5,  0.5,
     0.5, -0.5,  0.5,
     0.5,  0.5,  0.5,
    -0.5,  0.5,  0.5,
    // Back face
    -0.5, -0.5, -0.5,
    -0.5,  0.5, -0.5,
     0.5,  0.5, -0.5,
     0.5, -0.5, -0.5,
    // Top face
    -0.5,  0.5, -0.5,
    -0.5,  0.5,  0.5,
     0.5,  0.5,  0.5,
     0.5,  0.5, -0.5,
    // Bottom face
    -0.5, -0.5, -0.5,
     0.5, -0.5, -0.5,
     0.5, -0.5,  0.5,
    -0.5, -0.5,  0.5,
    // Right face
     0.5, -0.5, -0.5,
     0.5,  0.5, -0.5,
     0.5,  0.5,  0.5,
     0.5, -0.5,  0.5,
    // Left face
    -0.5, -0.5, -0.5,
    -0.5, -0.5,  0.5,
    -0.5,  0.5,  0.5,
    -0.5,  0.5, -0.5,
  ];

  const positionBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positionBuffer);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array(positions), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

  // Texture coordinates
  const textureCoordinates = [
    // Front
    0.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  1.0,
    0.0,  1.0,
    // Back
    0.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  1.0,
    0.0,  1.0,
    // Top
    0.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  1.0,
    0.0,  1.0,
    // Bottom
    0.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  1.0,
    0.0,  1.0,
    // Right
    0.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  1.0,
    0.0,  1.0,
    // Left
    0.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  0.0,
    1.0,  1.0,
    0.0,  1.0,
  ];

  const textureCoordBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, textureCoordBuffer);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array(textureCoordinates),
                gl.STATIC_DRAW);

  // Indices
  const indices = [
    0,  1,  2,      0,  2,  3,    // front
    4,  5,  6,      4,  6,  7,    // back
    8,  9, 10,      8, 10, 11,    // top
    12, 13, 14,     12, 14, 15,   // bottom
    16, 17, 18,     16, 18, 19,   // right
    20, 21, 22,     20, 22, 23,   // left
  ];
  const indexBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, indexBuffer);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,
      new Uint16Array(indices), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

  return {
    position: positionBuffer,
    textureCoord: textureCoordBuffer,
    indices: indexBuffer,
    vertexCount: indices.length,
  };
}

// Generate Kandinsky-style abstract texture
function createKandinskyTexture(size = 128) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = size;
  canvas.height = size;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // Fill background with light color
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f0f0';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

  // Draw random circles with bold colors
  const colors = ['#FF0000', '#00FF00', '#0000FF', '#FFFF00', '#FF00FF', '#00FFFF', '#000000'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(
      Math.random() * size,
      Math.random() * size,
      Math.random() * 20 + 5,
      0,
      Math.PI * 2
    );
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Draw some random lines
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(Math.random() * size, Math.random() * size);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.random() * size, Math.random() * size);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  const texture = gl.createTexture();
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, texture);
  gl.texImage2D(
    gl.TEXTURE_2D,
    0,
    gl.RGBA,
    gl.RGBA,
    gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
    canvas
  );
  gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);
  return texture;
}

// Create ground texture with Kandinsky style
function createGroundTexture(size = 128) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = size;
  canvas.height = size;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  ctx.fillStyle = '#d0b080'; // earth tone background
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

  // Draw abstract shapes
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(
      Math.random() * size,
      Math.random() * size,
      Math.random() * 10 + 2,
      0,
      Math.PI * 2
    );
    ctx.fillStyle = ['#7f7f7f','#3f3f3f','#bfbfbf'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)];
    ctx.fill();
  }

  const texture = gl.createTexture();
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, texture);
  gl.texImage2D(
    gl.TEXTURE_2D,
    0,
    gl.RGBA,
    gl.RGBA,
    gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
    canvas
  );
  gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.REPEAT);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.REPEAT);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);
  return texture;
}

// Create scene objects
const cubeBuffers = initCubeBuffers(gl);
const groundTexture = createGroundTexture();
const treeTexture = createKandinskyTexture(128);

// Define scene objects (positions)
const sceneObjects = [];

// Create ground plane (large flat cube)
const ground = {
  position: [0, -0.5, 0],
  scale: [50, 0.1, 50],
  texture: groundTexture,
  buffers: null,
};
sceneObjects.push(ground);

// Create some trees
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
  const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
  sceneObjects.push({
    position: [x, 0, z],
    scale: [1, 3, 1], // Tree trunk
    texture: treeTexture,
    buffers: cubeBuffers,
  });
}

// Initialize buffers for each object
sceneObjects.forEach(obj => {
  obj.buffers = cubeBuffers;
});

// Camera parameters
let cameraAngleX = 0;
let cameraAngleY = 0;
let cameraDistance = 60;

let isDragging = false;
let lastX = 0;
let lastY = 0;

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  isDragging = true;
  lastX = e.clientX;
  lastY = e.clientY;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (isDragging) {
    const deltaX = e.clientX - lastX;
    const deltaY = e.clientY - lastY;
    cameraAngleY += deltaX * 0.005;
    cameraAngleX += deltaY * 0.005;
    cameraAngleX = Math.max(-Math.PI/2, Math.min(Math.PI/2, cameraAngleX));
    lastX = e.clientX;
    lastY = e.clientY;
  }
});

// Animation loop
function render() {
  gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.canvas.width, gl.canvas.height);
  gl.clearColor(0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.0); // sky color

        // Scene setup

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        // Lighting

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Hand-drawn Kandinsky-style texture for trees
        function createKandinskyTexture(width, height) {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = width;
            canvas.height = height;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            
            // Background
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF8DC';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
            
            // Abstract geometric shapes in Kandinsky style
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            // Circles
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(width * 0.3, height * 0.3, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4500';
            ctx.fill();
            // Triangles
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(width * 0.7, height * 0.2);
            ctx.lineTo(width * 0.6, height * 0.4);
            ctx.lineTo(width * 0.8, height * 0.4);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1E90FF';
            ctx.fill();
            // Lines
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(width * 0.2, height * 0.6);
            ctx.lineTo(width * 0.8, height * 0.6);
            ctx.stroke();
            // Squares
            ctx.strokeRect(width * 0.4, height * 0.7, 30, 30);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
            ctx.fillRect(width * 0.4, height * 0.7, 30, 30);
            
            const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
            return texture;
        }

        // Create tree model with Kandinsky texture
        function createTree(x, z) {
            const treeGroup = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Trunk
            const trunkGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.2, 2, 8);
            const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 });
            const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(trunkGeometry, trunkMaterial);

            treeGroup.add(trunk);
            
            // Leaves with Kandinsky texture
            const leavesGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1.5, 2);
            const leavesMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ 
                map: createKandinskyTexture(256, 256),
                side: THREE.DoubleSide
            });
            const leaves = new THREE.Mesh(leavesGeometry, leavesMaterial);

                case 'd': moveRight = true; break;

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => {
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'w': moveForward = false; break;
                case 's': moveBackward = false; break;
                case 'a': moveLeft = false; break;
                case 'd': moveRight = false; break;
            }
        });

        // Mouse look controls
        let yawObject = new THREE.Object3D(); // For horizontal rotation
        scene.add(yawObject);
        yawObject.add(camera);
        let pitch = 0, yaw = 0;
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
            const sensitivity = 0.005;
            yaw -= event.movementX * sensitivity;
            pitch -= event.movementY * sensitivity;
            pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2, Math.min(Math.PI / 2, pitch));
            yawObject.quaternion.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, yaw, 0));
            camera.quaternion.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(pitch, yaw, 0));

            renderer.domElement.requestPointerLock();
        });

        // Animation loop with movement

            if (document.pointerLockElement === renderer.domElement) {

                if (moveBackward) camera.position.addScaledVector(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion), speed);
                if (moveLeft) camera.position.addScaledVector(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion), speed);
                if (moveRight) camera.position.addScaledVector(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion), speed);
